caption:
Figure 2. Diagram of our proposed method. Offline Labeller Training: we add a detector head to a frozen DINOv2 encoder and train
it with source images only. Offline Label Generation: we combine and freeze the labeller backbone and detector, and generate target
pseudo-labels. Online Student Training: We train a student network using source ground truth boxes and target pseudo-labels, and align
patch features to a frozen DINOv2 encoder. During inference, the alignment encoder and projection MLP are not used.
delegated_acceptance_review: Actually viewed the draft and final three-stage schematic, read the full original caption and independent checks. All original frozen/trainable modules, source ground-truth and target pseudo-label streams, offline-label and online-student branches, and four similarity-loss inputs remain intact in the restored graph. The new green-source/orange-target key agrees with original branch colors; omission of alignment encoder and projection MLP during inference is explicitly stated in the caption. The first draft is recorded as superseded for original-graph preservation, without claiming an unobserved semantic error.
